one_line: Founder and first sultan of the Bahmani Sultanate in the Deccan (r. 1347–1358 CE).

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium-tall, athletic but not bulky, with the posture of a disciplined commander who has marched with troops.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccani complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with slightly heavy lids, a faint vertical frown line between the brows; default expression is calm, calculating focus with a hint of sternness.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair kept relatively short and tidy, unseen under a deep teal cloth turban wrapped low and firm in a 14th‑century Indo‑Islamic style, with a narrow gold band at the base and a small, plain circular metal finial at the front instead of a feather.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid‑14th‑century Deccan sultan’s field attire: over a long‑sleeved, knee‑length quilted gambeson (light beige cotton with vertical stitching), he wears a fitted mail-and-plate coat (char-aina style) rendered as overlapping dark steel plates suggested under a smooth outer teal-blue textile facing, belted at the waist with a broad dark brown leather belt bearing a simple silver buckle; beneath, loose straight trousers (salwar/churidar) in muted earthy brown taper into sturdy dark leather boots rising just below the calf; over the armor sits a rich but practical outer robe (jamah) in deep indigo, opening in front, with narrow golden piping along the edges and cuffs and a subtle repeating geometric pattern (small diamond motifs) woven in a slightly lighter blue; a plain off‑white cotton sash (patka) is wrapped once around the waist over the belt, its ends hanging to mid‑thigh; he wears minimal jewellery—just a single thin gold band ring on his right hand and small, simple gold stud earrings—signalling status without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Deccani talwar with a plain steel blade, a simple disc pommel and narrow cross‑guard, carried sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with subtle brass fittings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Alauddin Bahman Shah is a medium-tall Deccani man in his late 30s with a neat dark beard, calm stern eyes, a deep teal turban, teal-blue mail-and-plate armor under an indigo robe with gold piping, earthy brown trousers, dark leather boots, and a plain-hilted talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Alauddin Bahman Shah, founder of the Bahmani Sultanate: a medium-tall Deccani man in his late 30s with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, his default expression calm and calculating with a faint frown line between the brows. His dark brown-black hair is covered by a deep teal cloth turban wrapped low and firm, with a narrow gold band at the base and a small plain circular metal finial at the front. Dress him in historically plausible mid-14th-century Deccan field attire: a light beige quilted gambeson under a fitted teal-blue mail-and-plate coat suggested by smooth teal textile with steel grey hints, cinched by a broad dark brown leather belt with a simple silver buckle. Over this, show a deep indigo outer robe opening in front, edged with narrow gold piping and a subtle repeating geometric diamond pattern in slightly lighter blue, its hem reaching just below the knees. Give him loose muted earthy brown trousers tapering into sturdy dark leather boots that rise just below the calf, and a plain off-white cotton sash wrapped once over the belt with its ends hanging to mid-thigh. Add minimal jewellery: a thin gold band ring on his right hand and small simple gold stud earrings. At his left hip, attach a slightly curved Deccani talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, featuring a plain steel blade, disc pommel and narrow cross-guard, with his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a restrained palette of deep indigo, teal blue, muted earthy brown, light beige, dark leather brown, steel grey, and small gold accents, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show face, turban, armor layers, robe, trousers, boots, and sword for consistent redrawing.
